Enum Class EventType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<EventType>
org.example.Model.EventType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<EventType>, Constable
public enum EventType extends Enum<EventType>
Enumeration of all possible event types in the simulation. Each value represents a specific event that can occur during the passenger flow through the airport system. These events are used by the simulation engine to determine what action should happen next when an event is processed.
